rule.title: 2024 Form 1040 line 36, the overpayment applied, is a 2025 line 26 payment as printed

citation.wording: Include any overpayment that you applied to your 2025 estimated tax from your 2024 return or an amended return.

rule.open_point: The leadsheet row prior-year-1040.36 already places this figure on line 26 (`to`), and the engine's figure pass skips an `introduces_printed` operator, so this rule records the provision and introduces nothing a second time. If a later engine ever introduces prior-year figures, it must do so INSTEAD of the row, or the overpayment is counted twice.
